Game Overview

Minigolf Clash is a sports game built around master the art of precision in Minigolf Clash. With top-down view courses, carefully plan each shot using tap-and-drag mechanics. Strategize around obstacles, minimize strokes, and secure your path to becoming a minigolf master. It's a delightful mix of technique, lighthearted fun, and friendly competition.
